annotations.title: Search CVE vulnerabilities (NVD, CISA KEV, EPSS)

description: New and updated vulnerabilities from the NVD with CVSS score and severity, CWE, affected vendors and products, references, CISA known-exploited status (date added, due date, ransomware use) and the EPSS exploit likelihood. Filter by vendor, product, keyword, severity, CVSS or EPSS, or look up CVE ids. Use for patch triage and security alerts. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/cve-feed on your Apify account (about $0.003 per CVE; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

cve_ids.description: Look up these CVEs instead, e.g. ["CVE-2024-3400"].

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

keywords.description: Words in the description, e.g. "remote code execution".

known_exploited_only.description: Only CVEs in the CISA known-exploited catalog.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 100, max 2000). Cost scales with this.

min_epss.description: Minimum probability of exploitation in the next 30 days (0-1).

source.description: nvd: CVEs published or modified in the window; kev: CVEs CISA added to its known-exploited catalog.

within_days.description: Look-back window in days (about 600-900 CVEs a day on NVD).

name: search_vulnerabilities

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search CVE vulnerabilities (NVD, CISA KEV, EPSS)
